reason: Owner directive 2026-11-03 (ADR0023) keeps required agents open-ended under the watchdog; fixed respawn allowances must not abandon actionable coverage or become delivery gates.

edits.before: If a worker drops out, proceed with N-1 and note it.
edits.after: If a worker drops out, keep independent work moving and use the installed [watchdog](../watchdog/SKILL.md) to recover a required slice. Name any unreachable prerequisite; a missing result is never a pass.

edits.before: Read the terminal results. Drop a result that does not record the SHAs and method its brief names, and respawn that worker once. After a second miss, record a gap. A gap does not count as a pass. For coverage, every required slice needs a result. For a race, apply the selection rule declared up front. Use first pass, rank all, or best-of. Do not paste raw worker dumps.
edits.after: Read the terminal results. A result that omits the SHAs or method its brief requires is incomplete. Recover the missing evidence under the installed [watchdog](../watchdog/SKILL.md), without a fixed retry or runtime allowance. For coverage, every required slice needs a result. For a race, apply the declared first-pass, rank-all or best-of selection rule. Report an unreachable prerequisite as a gap, never a pass. Do not paste raw worker dumps.
